tinker.name: Color
tinker.description: Color picker with format conversion and harmony schemes

zh-CN.name: 颜色
zh-CN.description: 颜色选择器，支持格式转换和配色方案

get.description: Get the current color in HEX/RGB/HSL/HSV/CMYK/LAB/HSI formats, plus alpha, complementary, analogous, and lightness variants.

set.description: Set the current color. Accepts CSS colors (e.g. #ff0000, rgb(255,0,0), hsl(0,100%,50%)) or comma-separated values matching the UI format fields. Updates the plugin UI and returns all formats.

format.description: Parse color as this format. Use for comma-separated UI values like "255, 0, 0". Optional for CSS colors.

alpha.description: Opacity percent (0-100). Defaults to the current UI value.
